title: Hammer Girl Triptych
description: Three-panel comic-style sequence showing a pink-haired female character in a pink and black outfit. Left panel: she stands confidently holding a giant purple and black mallet. Middle panel: she swings the mallet with motion lines and yellow impact stars. Right panel: she lies on the ground defeated as the mallet rests beside her.
prompt: Comic book triptych sequence on three separate grey panels. A confident punk girl with long bright pink hair in a high ponytail, wearing a pink and black outfit with gloves and boots, poses with a massive purple and black sledgehammer. In the center panel she swings the hammer powerfully with yellow starburst impact effects. In the final panel she is lying on her back on the ground, defeated, with the hammer resting beside her. Bold line art, vibrant colors, dynamic action pose sequence.
